notes: The abstract explicitly reports overall adverse events in 44 dapagliflozin and 38 placebo patients, respectively; this best matches the unqualified outcome Adverse events. Searched the registry outcomeMeasuresModule titles and descriptions, adverseEventsModule event terms, and eventGroups totals. The registry has posted results but no combined overall adverse-event participant count: seriousNumAffected is 31 versus 22, otherNumAffected is 13 versus 16, and deathsNumAffected is 1 versus 2 (dapagliflozin versus placebo). These are distinct outcomes/categories and were not substituted or summed. The other held CT.gov results file contains efficacy outcome measures, not an overall adverse-event count. Arm ownership and event counts therefore come from the abstract; group_id is null. The abstract prints only the combined randomized total, 324. Each arm denominator of 162 is independently printed in the registry participantFlowModule Overall Study STARTED achievements for FG000 (Dapagliflozin) and FG001 (Placebo), respectively, and is used as the trial-reported randomized denominator. No denominator was calculated from percentages.
